plan.notes: Official degree map: Psychology, BA, Roosevelt University Academic Catalog (current, non-archive catalog, accessed 2026-10-02). Catalog year not printed on the program page; recorded as 2026-2027 (the academic year in progress at access). All 8 semester totals and the program total (120) match the published degree map exactly (16/16/15/15/15/13/15/15). Degree maps publish course codes and credit hours; titles set to course codes (collection precedent for Roosevelt maps). Year 3 Spring includes a 1-credit General Elective exactly as the published map prints it (13 = 3+3+3+3+1). The four PSYC area groups are transcribed verbatim from the map: area choices are PSYC 316/325/326/336/350 (biological/cognitive), PSYC 211/220/345/366 (social), PSYC 243/254/339/341/381 (developmental), PSYC 201/215/270/319/344/347/351 (clinical/applied); the map's 'Complete all four PSYC Areas' checkpoint is noted on Year 4 Fall. Program notes: 36 hours in Psychology; PSYC 103 must be taken as soon as the major is declared; PSYC 200 and PSYC 285 should be completed within the first two to three semesters; 21 hours at Roosevelt including 9 at the 300 level; 12 total hours of 300-level PSYC; C- minimum grade for major courses; Experiential Learning class must be 200/300 level (Psychology options include PSYC 350, 360, 366, 368, 381, 393, 398, 399). The map publishes no per-course prerequisite list; prereqs left empty.
